Axiom:
The ticket is orchestrator-owned. During phase work the only ticket writer is the exact `sdd-verify --task ... --phase ...` command, and it writes only its CLI-owned receipt. The worker returns event facts, deviations, and typed Handoff in its response; it never calls `sdd-log` and never manually edits any ticket section.
After validating the worker response against Git and the receipt, the orchestrator calls `npx gennady sdd-log complete "" --phase P`. That one atomic transition replaces only the current phase's skeleton DONE/Handoff placeholders and changes only that phase's `Phases Overview` Status to `[x]`. Other `sdd-log` modes remain orchestrator-owned structured writes for Round/blocker events. Manual ticket edits are forbidden for both worker and orchestrator when a structured mode exists.
Any change to Phases definitions, Rules lists, Target Files, BDD scenarios, Verification table, Dependencies, or existing Decision Log facts → `H_OUT_OF_PHASE_WRITE` and returns to the owning planning/approval boundary.
